entries.name: com.apple.dt.automationmode-writer
entries.note: Sets the developer tools' automation mode for UI test automation on the vendor's systems; BifrOSt tests run through cargo and the headless testkit.

entries.name: com.apple.dt.fetchsymbolsd

entries.name: com.apple.dvdplayback.setregion
entries.note: Sets the region code of an optical drive through a vendor service; region is a drive firmware setting with no BifrOSt service behind it.

entries.name: com.apple.dynamic_pager
entries.note: bifrostd sets up a zram swap of half the RAM (at most 8 GiB) at boot (bifrost-zram.service), adds 1 GiB swap files in /var/lib/bifrost/swap under PSI pressure when swap is under 25 % free, removes unused ones after 10 min of calm, and publishes normal/warn/critical to /run/bifrost/memory-pressure (bifrost_app::memory_pressure). Gaps: the pager runs inside bifrostd, which starts after the first desktop frame, so disk swap files are not added before the desktop; not verified on a device.
